guides.explain: Explore our official guides and tutorials to get the most out of FreightIQ AI Voice Agent
guides.hero.title: FreightIQ AI Guide
guides.hero.subtitle: Welcome to the complete FreightIQ operational manual. This guide will walk you through the advanced configuration of your Voice Agent and the daily management of the platform.
guides.toc.title: Table of Contents
guides.toc.config: 2. Configuration: The Heart of the Voice Agent
guides.kb.title: Knowledge Base
guides.kb.objective.title: Section Objective
guides.kb.objective.desc: The "Knowledge Base" interface is intended for uploading and managing the documents that form your Voice Agent's knowledge base. Without this data, the agent would only respond generically; by uploading your documents, you make it an expert on your company.
guides.kb.upload.title: Uploading Documents
guides.kb.upload.desc: The top area of the interface features a dashed box dedicated to file uploads:
guides.kb.upload.method: Upload method: Drag and drop (drag the file into the area) or select via file system browsing by clicking on the central area.
guides.kb.upload.formats: Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV, HTML, MD.
guides.kb.upload.limit: Size limit: Maximum 50 MB per single file.
guides.kb.search.title: Search and Filters
guides.kb.search.desc: Below the upload area is a text search bar ("Search documents...") used to filter the list of uploaded files. Above the bar, the total count of documents in the system is shown.
guides.kb.table.title: Document Table
guides.kb.table.desc: Processed documents are organized in a structured table with the following columns:
guides.kb.table.name: NAME: Original file name and size (e.g., 4.0 MB).
guides.kb.table.status: STATUS: Processing status. The value "Indexed" (green icon) confirms that the text was successfully extracted and integrated.
guides.kb.table.pages: PAGES: Total number of pages detected.
guides.kb.table.chunks: CHUNKS: Data fragments into which the document was segmented to optimize AI search.
guides.kb.table.created: CREATED: Exact date and time of addition.
guides.kb.table.actions: ACTIONS: "View" button for details and three-dot menu for additional options.
guides.config.title: Configuration
guides.config.objective.title: Section Objective
guides.config.objective.desc: The "Config" page, located in the "Voice Agent" module, centralizes the agent's behavior, response, and integration settings. The system uses a preset-based architecture, allowing specific operational configurations to be applied as needed.
guides.config.nav.title: Configuration Navigation Panel
guides.config.nav.level.title: Configuration Level
guides.config.nav.level.desc: Selection between "My presets" (custom) and "Global defaults" (system). The "ACTIVE PRESET" indicator shows the profile currently running.
guides.config.nav.presets.title: Preset Management
guides.config.nav.presets.desc: "+ New preset" button to create profiles from scratch. List with metadata (name, status, language, update).
guides.config.nav.params.title: Parameters
guides.config.nav.params.desc: Main area where parameters are grouped into expandable categories.
guides.config.params.title: Preset Parameterization
guides.config.params.details.desc: Name, description, primary language, and System Prompt (base instructions for the AI) with configurable opening messages.
guides.config.params.tools.desc: Enable/disable technical capabilities with the "Optional description override" option. This allows you to instruct the AI on when to use a tool:
guides.config.params.model.desc: Manages generative penalties (frequency, repetition, presence) and RAG mechanics (Top-K, score threshold, context character limit, and timeout).
guides.config.params.behavior.desc: Toggles for "Allow interruptions", "Reflect on results", and "Thinking mode". Timing settings for filler phrases and inactivity timeout.
guides.config.params.recording.desc: Tag configuration, auto-inference of category/priority, and constraints (Require phone lookup). Audio recording management with multilingual privacy disclaimer.
guides.tickets.title: Ticket System
guides.tickets.objective.title: Section Objective
guides.tickets.objective.desc: Environment dedicated to monitoring and managing requests, automatically generated by the Voice Agent or entered manually.
guides.tickets.ui.title: Interface and Search
guides.tickets.ui.desc: Top bar with text search ("Search tickets...") and filters for Status, Priority, and Date Added. Quick buttons for "Automation" and "+ Add Ticket".
guides.tickets.automation.title: Email Automation
guides.tickets.automation.desc: Panel to configure immediate alerts to the team:
guides.tickets.automation.enable: Enable automation: Global toggle for alerts.
guides.tickets.automation.active: Active recipient: Confirms the address with any overrides.
guides.tickets.detail.title: Ticket Detail
guides.tickets.detail.notifications: Notification Status: Email sending track with "Sent" badge.
guides.tickets.detail.metadata: Metadata: Category, assignee, and voice session ID.
guides.tickets.detail.message: Original Message: Agent summary or transcript (editable).
guides.tickets.detail.params: Parameter Management: Statuses are fixed (Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed), while Priority and Categories are configured in the "Configuration" section of the Voice Agent.
guides.operations.title: Operational Monitoring
guides.operations.desc: The Operations page provides real-time telemetry. It is the primary tool for verifying system health.
guides.operations.sessions: Active Sessions: Instant monitoring of calls in progress.
guides.operations.feed: Live Feed: Streaming of JSON events. Every action (call status change, DB errors, tool execution) is logged here for technical debugging.
guides.operations.success: Success Rate: Last 24 hours analysis to identify performance drops.
guides.account.title: Account and Team
guides.account.orgs: Organizations: Data is isolated. You can manage multiple companies or departments by switching between them without mixing documents or tickets.
guides.account.invites: Team Invites: Admins can invite collaborators via email, defining roles (Admin or Member) to limit access to sensitive agent configurations.
guides.next.title: Where to next
guides.next.desc: Put the guide into practice. Jump straight into the tools you just read about.
guides.next.config.desc: Open the configuration presets and shape how your agent speaks and acts.
guides.next.operations.desc: Follow real-time sessions and the event feed on the Operations dashboard.
